http2.sai（13 个）

sa_std_http2_supported(&out_supported: ptr) -> i32sa_std HTTP/2 surface — real libnghttp2 backend living in the sci runtime. String/JSON/binary outputs are returned as registered u64 buffer handles, following the same convention as sa_std.fs.read_*: read bytes/length with sa_std_http2_buffer_data / sa_std_http2_buffer_len and release with sa_std_http2_buffer_free.
